items.title: 8.5 Podon mein pani ki naqal (transport) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.5, printed pages 184-187.

blocks.text: Jaron ke zariye pani lena (uptake)

Podon ki jarein (roots) bohat zyada shakhon mein phail kar pani jazb karne ke liye bara surface area deti hain. Aap jante hain ke jaron par bohat chhote root hairs hote hain, jo asal mein jar ke epidermal cells ke hi barhe hue hisse hain. Jaron mein pani aur minerals zyada tar root hairs ke zariye hi andar aate hain.

Mitti se pani aur minerals active transport (energy laga kar) aur passive transport (baghair energy ke) se jar ke epidermal cells mein dakhil hote hain. Epidermis se yeh cortex mein jate hain, aur phir jar ke beech mein maujood xylem tissue tak pohnchte hain. Jar ke andar pani aur minerals xylem tak pohnchne ke liye teen mukhtalif raston (pathways) se jate hain.
1. Apoplast pathway

Yeh jar ke saath saath jure hue cell walls ka ek musalsal (lagataar) rasta hai. Endodermis mein Casparian strips (kitab inhen 'Casparian segments' kehti hai) ki wajah se yeh rasta toot jata hai, yani wahan pani ko cell walls chhor kar cells ke andar se guzarna parta hai.
2. Symplast pathway

Symplast raste mein pani aur minerals jar ke cells ke aapas mein jure protoplasts (cell ke andar ka zinda hissa) se guzarte hain. Saath wale cells ke protoplasts plasmodesmata se jure hote hain; plasmodesmata cytoplasm ke patle dhaage hain jo saath wali cell walls ke surakhon se guzarte hain. Symplast rasta kam aham hai, siwaye endodermis ke ilaqe mein minerals ke liye.
3. Vacuolar pathway

Vacuolar raste mein pani aur minerals cell membranes, cytoplasm, tonoplast (vacuole ki jhilli) aur vacuoles ke andar se guzarte hain. Yeh ek vacuole se doosre vacuole mein jate hain aur symplast aur apoplast raston ko chhor dete hain. Is raste se harkat na hone ke barabar (negligible) hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch milte julte cells ki qatar, har ek mein cell wall, gulabi cytoplasm aur beech mein vacuole jis ki hadd tonoplast hai; padosi cells plasmodesmata se jure hain. Kale teer cell walls mein (apoplast), narangi teer cytoplasm aur plasmodesmata se (symplast), aur neele teer ek vacuole se doosre vacuole tak (vacuolar) chalte hain. Labels: Plasmodesmata, Tonoplast, Vacuole, Cell wall, Cytoplasm.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7: Apoplast, symplast aur vacuolar raston se pani ki harkat (kitab ki Figure 8.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen rang, teen raste: kala rasta sirf cell walls se guzarta hai aur koi membrane paar nahin karta (apoplast). Narangi rasta ek cell ke cytoplasm se plasmodesmata ke zariye agle cell ke cytoplasm mein jata hai (symplast). Neela rasta har cell ke vacuole se guzarta hai, is liye har baar tonoplast paar karna parta hai (vacuolar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.7 ki caption mein “vacoular” chhapa hai; sahi spelling “vacuolar” hai (vacuole se bana lafz), jo yahan likhi gayi hai.
Xylem tissue ki banawat

Xylem podon ka woh vascular tissue (pani aur ghiza le jane wala tissue) hai jo pani aur us mein ghule minerals ko jaron se tane aur patton tak le jata hai. Yeh pode ki banawat ka aham hissa bhi hai aur pode ke jism ko mechanical sahara deta hai.
Xylem mein tracheids, vessels, xylem fibres aur xylem parenchyma hote hain (kitab yahan Fig. 8.7 likhti hai; xylem ke hisse Figure 8.8 mein hain).

Tracheids lambe aur patle cells hain jin ki deewarein lignin ki wajah se moti hoti hain. In ke sire nokeele (tapered) hote hain aur yeh bordered pits ke zariye aapas mein jure hote hain; in pits se pani ek cell se saath wale cell mein pehlu ki taraf (lateral) ja sakta hai. Vessels tracheids ke muqable mein chhote aur chaure hote hain. Yeh ek seedhi qatar mein lage hote hain aur musalsal naliyan bana dete hain. In ke siron par perforation plates (surakh wali deewarein) hoti hain jin se pani asani se guzarta hai. Xylem fibres lambe cells hain jin ki deewarein lignin se moti hoti hain. Pak jane par yeh murda ho jate hain aur xylem ko mazbooti dete hain; yeh pode ko izafi sahara bhi dete hain. Xylem parenchyma zinda cells hain jin ki deewarein patli hoti hain aur jo nutrients aur pani ko rok kar rakh sakte hain. Xylem parenchyma pani aur nutrients ko pehlu ki taraf le jane mein hissa lete hain aur xylem tissue ke zakhm bharne aur dobara banne mein bhi madad kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Xylem ke chaar qism ke cells saath saath. Fibre: lamba dukla-numa (spindle) cell, moti deewar aur darar jaise pits. Tracheid: lambi patli gehri nali, nokeele ek doosre par charhe sire aur pits. Vessel: chauri khuli nali jis ki deewaron mein pits. Xylem parenchyma: teen zinda cells ka sutoon, har ek mein cytoplasm aur nucleus, aakhri deewaron mein pits. Labels: Fibre, Tracheid, Vessel, Xylem Parenchyma, Cytoplasm, Nucleus, Pit.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.8: Xylem tissue ke mukhtalif hisse (kitab ki Figure 8.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tracheids aur vessels murda, khali naliyan hain jin se pani oopar jata hai; pits se pani ek nali se doosri mein chala jata hai. Fibres sirf mazbooti dete hain. Xylem parenchyma hi zinda hissa hai, is liye sirf us mein nucleus aur cytoplasm dikhaye gaye hain; yeh khoorak aur pani zakheera karta hai.
Xylem ke zariye pani ki harkat

Podon mein pani jaron se patton tak zyada tar ek khaas vascular tissue, xylem, ke zariye jata hai. TACT (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) mechanism ek aam taur par mana hua model hai jo batata hai ke pani gravity (zameen ki kashish) ke khilaf xylem mein oopar ja kar pode ke har hisse tak kaise pohnchta hai. Yeh mechanism pani ki physical aur chemical khasoosiyat aur pode ke apne mahol ke saath taalluq par munhasir hai.

Transpiration woh amal hai jis mein patton ki satah se, khaas taur par stomata ke zariye, pani bhaap ban kar urta hai. Jab pani ki bhaap patte se nikalti hai to patte ke tissue mein negative pressure (kheenchne wala dabao) banta hai. Yeh negative pressure ek kheenchne wali quwwat (pulling force) paida karta hai jo pani ko jaron se tane ke raste patton ki taraf oopar kheenchti hai. Is liye transpiration xylem mein pani ke jane ki sab se bari wajah (primary driving force) hai.

Adhesion pani ke molecules aur xylem vessels ki deewaron ke darmiyan kashish (attraction) hai. Is kashish ki wajah se pani ke molecules oopar jate hue xylem ki deewaron se chipke rehte hain. Is se xylem mein pani ka column (dhaara) kahin se tootta nahin. Is tarah adhesion pani ke column ko jura hua rakhne mein bohat aham hai, khaas taur par oonche podon mein jahan gravity pani ko zor se neeche kheenchti hai.

Cohesion khud pani ke molecules ke aapas ki kashish hai, jo hydrogen bonding se hoti hai. Xylem mein pani ke molecules ek doosre se chipak kar jaron se patton tak ek an-toota (unbroken) column bana lete hain. Pani ki is khasoosiyat ki wajah se patte par transpiration se shuru hone wala “khinchao” (pull) poore column mein neeche tak pohnchta hai.

Tension woh negative pressure hai jo patte par transpiration ki kheenchne wali quwwat se banta hai. Jab pani patte ki satah se urta hai to kam dabao ka ilaqa banta hai jo xylem mein neeche tak phail jata hai. Yeh tension jure hue pani ke column ko oopar kheenchti hai. Is liye xylem mein pani ke lagataar oopar charhne ke liye tension bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Beech mein darakht aur baen taraf teen bare kiye hue dabbe. Patte ka dabba: mesophyll cells, xylem aur stoma, surkh teer xylem se stoma ke raste bahar; Transpiration draws water from the leaf. Tane ka dabba: xylem ke sutoon aur upar jate surkh teer; Cohesion and adhesion draw water up the xylem. Jar ka dabba: mitti ke zarre, pani ke molecules, root hair aur xylem, surkh teer andar; Negative water potential draws water into the root.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani hamesha zyada water potential se kam water potential ki taraf jata hai. Jar (−0.2 MPa) se tana (−0.6 MPa), patta (−1.5 MPa) aur hawa (−100 MPa) tak qeemat ghatti jati hai, is liye pani khud ba khud oopar khinchta hai. Patton se bhaap ban kar urna (transpiration) khinchao (tension) paida karta hai, aur cohesion aur adhesion pani ke column ko tootne nahin dete.

blocks.prompt: Ek darakht ke patton par aisa spray kiya jata hai jo stomata band kar deta hai. TACT ki madad se batayein ke us ke xylem mein pani ke bahao ka kya hoga.
blocks.explanation: Stomata band hon to transpiration ruk jati hai: na bhaap nikalti hai, na patte mein negative pressure banta hai. Tension na ho to pani ke column ko oopar kheenchne wali koi quwwat nahin rehti. Adhesion aur cohesion column ko jura to rakhte hain magar woh ruk jata hai, is liye xylem mein pani ka oopar jana bohat kam ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Root hairs pani aur minerals lete hain; jar mein yeh apoplast (cell walls; endodermis par Casparian strip se rukawat), symplast (plasmodesmata ke zariye cytoplasm) ya bohat kam vacuolar raste se xylem tak jate hain.
Xylem: tracheids (nokeele sire, bordered pits), vessels (perforation plates, musalsal naliyan), fibres (lignin, murda, sahara) aur parenchyma (zinda, zakheera, pehlu ki harkat, marammat).
TACT: transpiration tension banati hai; adhesion aur cohesion pani ka an-toota column rakhte hain jise tension jar se patte tak oopar kheenchti hai.
